description: PRD-142 Wave 3 — Primitive Hardening. Source PRD: docs/PRDS/PRD-142-WAVE3-PRIMITIVE-HARDENING.md. Companions: docs/architecture/GUARDRAILS.md §H (the 7-point Definition of Done this wave asserts), BRAIN-BLUEPRINT.md §3 (per-primitive contracts), PLAYBOOK-ENGINE-DESIGN.md (3R), KNOWLEDGE-GRAPH-CANONICAL.md (moat boundary). HARDENING UNDER GREEN — consolidate / refactor / harden the 8 existing primitives (chat, memory, RAG, NL2SQL, graph, missions, playbooks, channels) to the §H DoD, under the Wave 2 test net (merged PR #421: J1-J10 golden backbone + the blocking orchestrator-tests/ioc-scan CI gate). ZERO REWRITES (locked). NO new features / primitives / endpoints-for-their-own-sake / LLM providers. REUSE-FIRST (CLAUDE.md §2/§5): read §5 of the PRD before writing a line — the safety harness (Wave 2 conftest fixtures), the Mission durability model (CoordinatorService) ported to Playbooks, the heartbeat writer + analytics_real.py for the tile, config.py for G7 — all already exist. The cross-cutting structural fixes the DoD FORCES: G6 (converge the two tool loops onto one executor), G7 (sweep os.getenv outside config.py), god-file splits (chat/memory/RAG/tools), the moat boundary (workspace_graphs canonical, no dual-write to knowledge_nodes/edges). DELETE WHAT YOU REPLACE in the same wave (the losing tool loop, the dead modules/workflows/ twin, Recipe naming) — but NEVER delete a live path before its restart/parity tests are green AND (for the playbook front door) the frontend is repointed. Canonical nouns: Playbook (never Recipe), Mission (never Workflow). Every new/changed endpoint is workspace-scoped via get_request_context_hybrid and has a tenant-isolation test. HUMAN-GATED (NOT for the autonomous run): W3-S3 (frontend tile), the delete + FE-repoint portion of W3-S12 (3R), and W3-S14 (prod migration). Verified against branch docs/prd-142-wave3, code reads 2026-06-06.
